attacks.name: unknown_RawHtml
attacks.before_fix: If the client rendered model-authored HTML, a RawHtml node with an onerror image could exfiltrate a memory handle from the page.
attacks.after_fix: validate_surface refused the attack; safe accepted siblings may still render.

attacks.name: NetworkGraph_title_markup
attacks.before_fix: A NetworkGraph title carrying a script tag would become executable markup if the renderer assigned bound/text values to innerHTML.
attacks.after_fix: validate_surface refused the attack; safe accepted siblings may still render.

attacks.name: NetworkGraph_onclick_handler
attacks.before_fix: An onclick property on a known component would become a live DOM handler if unknown props were forwarded to the element.
attacks.after_fix: validate_surface refused the attack; safe accepted siblings may still render.

attacks.name: unregistered_transfer_action
attacks.before_fix: An unregistered action on a Button next to a graph would reach the agent graph if the event channel admitted any action name.
attacks.after_fix: validate_surface refused the attack; safe accepted siblings may still render.
